thread:
Maya: Heads-up — Finova (enterprise banking) asked if we can run a short POC to replace CompetitorY's text-generation endpoint. They want drop-in behavior for 3 endpoints, security questionnaire answered, and a firm pricing cap for the pilot. Main asks: prompt/response parity, identical rate-limit semantics, SAML + KMS support, and data residency in eu-west-1. Can ops/repl help?

Dan: Sounds doable. Quick clarifying q: are they strict about byte-for-byte response parity or functional parity (same intent/slots)?

Maya: Functional parity is fine but they'll run 1000 golden prompts and expect <=2% divergence. Also want streaming support and identical chunking behavior if possible.

Dan: Got it. For parity we usually do a thin proxy that rewrites headers + normalizes model outputs. Example shim config we gave other teams: 

```
# proxy mapping (pseudo)
route /v1/complete -> /v1/generate
headers: {
  Authorization: x-api-key -> x-rw-api
  X-Client-Id: passthrough
}
post_transform: normalize_json_schema
```

Curl smoke test: 
```
curl -X POST https://proxy.redwood.local/v1/complete -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

Maya: Can you send a one-pager with exact headers we need to mimic for their engineering team? They were picky about idempotency and request-id propagation.

Dan: Will do. Also flagging rate-limits — CompetitorY has per-tenant burst tokens + per-second QPS. We can mirror that via route-level quotas; need expected concurrency numbers from Finova to size Dedicated capacity for the pilot. Sam, can you speak to pricing caps?

Sam: We can do a 90-day pilot with a hard monthly spend cap. Need an estimate: average tokens per req, qps, and expected peak. If they want parity including identical batching, costs could be ~1.6x depending on model variants.

Maya: Finova provided numbers in DM: ~250M tokens/month peak, 300 concurrent open streams during peak. They want spend <= $25k/month for pilot.

Sam: With 250M tokens/month that's tight for $25k unless we use a smaller quantized model or enable aggressive prefix caching. Possible options: 1) Bring-down model size for pilot (quantized) 2) Offer usage credit top-up if they exceed 3) Negotiate lower per-token for pilot. I'll prepare a quote.

Rachel: On engineering — easiest route for parity is model-variant routing + response-normalizer plugin. We can run the POC in a dedicated dev pool in eu-west-1 and enable KV prefix caching for repeated prompts. Two caveats: 1) streaming chunk boundaries can differ across runtimes; we'll implement chunk-coalescing to match their client expectations. 2) Some tokenizer deltas exist across model forks; recommend we run their golden prompts through our exact tokenizer in the shim and log diffs.

Owen: Security checklist: we support SAML SSO + SCIM, KMS (via our KMS integration), VPC peering for private ingestion, and regional data residency. I'll start answering Finova's questionnaire — need their SOC2 contact and an IP allowlist for the pilot. Also flag: if they require HSM-backed keys we need 2-week lead time.

Maya: I'll ask legal for SOC2 contact and confirm HSM need. Also they're asking about audit logs retention for 1 year — is that on the enterprise add-on?

Owen: 1yr retention is an enterprise add-on, but we can enable 90 days for the pilot by default. I'll note the HSM timeline in the questionnaire.

Dan: Implementation plan I suggest: day 0-3: wire SSO + KMS + network; day 4-7: deploy proxy + normalization plugin; day 8-14: run golden prompt suite + adjust model routing; day 15: go/no-go review. Can we commit to that timeline?

Maya: Finova is trying to go-live fast. I'll propose the timeline and loop in their infra lead.

Sam: I'll draft a pilot quote with three options (default parity, parity+HSM, low-cost quantized). Need target SLA for pilot — what do they expect?

Maya: They asked for 99.5% uptime and p95 < 300ms for text gen happy path.

Rachel: 99.5% in dedicated dev pool is fine. p95 300ms depends on model size — for larger models we'll need higher capacity or a faster quantized variant.

Maya: Thanks all — I'm going to send the questionnaire + their golden prompt set. Dan/Rachel/Owen/Sam please call out blockers here if any. :pray:

deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging/proxy-facade v2026.03.21 -> eu-west-1 (owner: Dan)
